title: Optimal Inflow Control for Transport Equations with Uncertain Velocities and Demand
summary: We study optimal inflow control for a linear transport equation subject to uncertainty in both time-dependent downstream demand and transport velocity. The random velocity induces a random travel time and thereby changes the relation between an inflow decision and the demand observed at its arrival time. For a fixed downstream observation window, we derive explicit optimal controls in the continuous-time setting and for piecewise constant controls.
